text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Mainichi Okan, where Grass Wonder is set to face both Silence Suzuka and El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The showdown of the century against the Otherworldly Front-Runner and the Phantom Bird. This is Grass Wonder's chance to surpass them both.
